audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Builderr Simulator Parity Assessment

order_sequencing.host_simulator_behavior: Strict Sell-First Pass: All sell orders across the portfolio are executed and cash credited before any buy orders are processed.
order_sequencing.naive_preview_behavior: List-Order Sequential: Orders processed in raw dictionary/list emission order.
order_sequencing.divergence_mechanism: If cash is low and emission list places BUY before SELL, naive preview fails the BUY due to lack of cash, whereas host executes SELL first and BUY succeeds.
order_sequencing.authoritative_rule: Host Sell-First Pass is AUTHORITATIVE. Preview and backtest engines must sort orders (sells first, buys second) to ensure 100% parity.

decision_and_fill_timing.decision_timestamp: T close (16:00 ET) using causal information available at market close.
decision_and_fill_timing.execution_timestamp: T+1 open (09:30 ET) using opening auction or first bar print.
decision_and_fill_timing.authoritative_rule: Decision at T close, fill at T+1 open. No lookahead.

cash_affordability_and_clamping.whole_share_constraint: Strict integer truncation: shares = floor(target_dollars / fill_price). Fractional shares rejected.
cash_affordability_and_clamping.cash_clamp_rule: If buy orders exceed available spendable cash, shares are scaled down to math.floor(spendable_cash / (price * (1 + slippage_bps/10000))).
cash_affordability_and_clamping.margin_prohibition: Cash balances must remain strictly >= 0.0. Margin borrowing is prohibited.

transaction_costs.slippage_model: 5.0 basis points (0.0005) applied symmetrically: Buy price = mid * 1.0005; Sell price = mid * 0.9995.
transaction_costs.brokerage_fees: Zero commission assumed for standard US equity brokers; explicit fee per share/trade injectable without violating balance identity.

settlement_and_proceeds.simulator_assumption: Instantaneous same-day reinvestment: sale proceeds immediately available for buying within the same execution batch.
settlement_and_proceeds.real_world_broker_rule: Under SEC T+1 settlement and broker margin/cash rules, proceeds from sales at open can be reinvested on same day for non-day-trading holds (Reg T / good faith violations apply only if purchased securities are sold before settlement).
settlement_and_proceeds.authoritative_rule: Simulator same-batch reinvestment is aligned with broker good-faith trading rules for long-only portfolios.

concentration_limits.single_asset_cap: 50% of total portfolio equity per position.
concentration_limits.enforcement_mechanism: Clamped during target weight generation in agent strategy logic.

parity_verification_verdict.preview_vs_host_parity: FULL PARITY ACHIEVED when sell-first ordering is enforced.
parity_verification_verdict.remote_submission: NONE (All tests conducted strictly offline with synthetic and local fixtures).
